name: Software Descriptor
description: Generic identity contract any software MAY implement. Defines the describe operation for self-identification — name, version, description, homepage, repository, maintainer. Implementations MAY return additional fields beyond the minimum.

SoftwareIdentity.description: Identity and metadata for a piece of software. Implementations may include additional fields.

description.description: Brief description of what this software does.

homepage.description: URL to documentation or project page.

openbindings.software-descriptor.describ.description: Return identity and metadata about this software. This operation is idempotent: repeating it with the same input in context that does not change its intended effects produces no additional intended operation-level effects after the first application. This does not promise identical results or authorize retries.
